title: Section Nine
logline: Michael reads Gerald Boyd's letters as a mandate to make the whole office love him, starting with a Love Board follow-up that runs straight into Toby's fire code, while Pam finally faces Jim's card and Angela and Kelly fight over the Spring Social.
outline: A: Michael turns the Gerald Boyd letters into a mandate (Love Board 2.0) and makes Toby's Section 9 objection personal; B: Pam hides Jim's card while Roy pushes the wedding, and Michael's selfless turn puts her on the phone instead of covering; C: Angela and Kelly/Phyllis fight over the Spring Social (hearts vs. garden), Angela leans on Dwight. Order: cold, A, B, C, A, B, A, C, B, A, tag. Michael drives A.
theme: Being loved means being present, not being on the board.
storySoFar: Jim is in Stamford settling in, calling and writing Pam carefully. Pam keeps Jim's card on her desk unanswered and drafts replies she never sends; Roy keeps pushing the June 14 wedding. Michael covered for Pam on Jim's call and said nothing; Pam heard and said thank you. Michael reads Gerald Boyd's letters as a mandate and starts Love Board 2.0, with Dwight and Andy as co-chairs who hate each other. Toby objects under Section 9 (HR Form 14-B) and Michael makes it personal. Angela's Party Planning Committee is split: Kelly and Phyllis want a Sweetheart Social, Angela wants a Garden Party, and she leans on Dwight. Dwight and Angela's secret is known to Oscar and Kevin. Stanley is at 195.

stateChanges.progress: Pam rereads Jim's card alone and drafts a voicemail; she leaves a four-word message and hangs up before finishing. She has not told Jim that Michael covered for her. Roy's binder and June 14 keep pressing.

stateChanges.arc: Michael Wants to Be the Favorite
stateChanges.progress: Michael treats Gerald Boyd's letters as a mandate and launches Love Board 2.0. Toby's blank card gets a real one from Toby: 'be present.' Michael's selfless move: he hands Pam the phone instead of covering for her.

stateChanges.arc: Dwight vs Andy for Number Two
stateChanges.progress: Dwight and Andy are co-chairs of Love Board 2.0 by Michael's decree and still fight over who is Chair.
195 days in the tag. Stanley gives Michael a grudging 'Mm.'

stateChanges.text: Michael's 'That's what she said' to Stanley's countdown dies on silence again; Kevin's 'Nobody say nothing.' closes cold open and tag.
Andy's bear-paw banjo hold music; Oscar: 'Actually, that's a banjo on hold.'
Pam has not told Jim that Michael covered for her on the phone. Michael now says he won't lie for her again.
Toby's card to Michael says 'be present'; Michael's Love Board 2.0 card-reading is on the break room board beside the laminated Section 9 notice.
Angela and Kelly/Phyllis Spring Social split: hearts on the right, cats (Angela's) on the left.

scenes.recap: Andy's banjo hold music, Stanley's 196 days, and Michael's joke dies on silence.

beats.caption: holds up his bear-paw phone; banjo hold music plays

beats.text: Actually, that's a banjo on hold.
It's a Cornell hold. Respect it.
One hundred ninety-six.
One ninety-six. That's what she said.

beats.caption: Stanley does not look up from his crossword

beats.text: Nobody say nothing.

scenes.recap: Pam rereads Jim's card in secret, and Michael offers to start a Love Board follow-up for her.

beats.caption: unfolds Jim's Stamford card from the reception drawer

lines: He wrote that Stamford has no Pretzel Day. And he thought of me.
I've read it nine times. That's not a number I'm proud of.

beats.text: Is that a Jim card? I can start a Love Board follow-up. Love needs a system.
It's a card, Michael.
Did he say anything about me?
No.

beats.caption: Michael waits for more
slides the card back under the stapler in the drawer

beats.text: He's gonna respect that.

scenes.recap: Michael announces Love Board 2.0 as a mandate from Gerald Boyd's letters, and Toby objects under Section 9.

beats.text: Corporate sent me letters. Gerald Boyd's letters, praising me. That's a mandate.
False. Those letters were written by us.
Dwight, we don't talk about the letters.
So we're doing Love Board 2.0. Every desk writes a card for every person.
I'll be Chair of the Board. I have a memo.
I'll write the most cards. Cornell wrote the most cards.
You're co-chairs. You'll hate each other, which is great.
The board is over the fire extinguisher. HR needs a Form 14-B.
Toby, you want to put my love in a form?
It's Section 9.
Love is a mandate. Corporate has spoken.

beats.caption: Toby stares at the table

scenes.recap: Kelly and Phyllis propose a Sweetheart Social; Angela wants a Garden Party and recruits Dwight.

beats.text: Hearts. Pink. It's a Sweetheart Social, and it's happening.
The Party Planning Committee has a Spring Garden Party. I approved it.
Bob thinks sweethearts are romantic.
Bob Vance is not on my committee.
Bob Vance is on everything, Angela.
Dwight, you'll sign the garden form with me.
Question: is this an alliance, or a secret?
It's a committee, Dwight.

lines: Kelly quit my committee and took Phyllis with her.
Now they want the Spring Social to be about love. I approve of tablecloths.

scenes.recap: Roy arrives with a wedding binder and asks whether Jim called.

beats.caption: sketches in the margin of a wedding seating chart

beats.text: June fourteenth. I got a binder.
Roy, that's a lot of binder.
I'm trying. You see me trying?
I see you.
Did Jim call? I'm asking. Not in a weird way.
No.

beats.caption: Roy looks at the drawer

beats.text: Cool. Cool.

lines: It's a binder. Binders are commitment.
She's drawing again. I can see the pencil. It's fine. It's fine.

scenes.recap: Toby laminates a Section 9 notice over the Things I Love board, and Michael makes it personal.

beats.caption: tacks a laminated HR notice over the Things I Love board

beats.text: You laminated it? That's an act of war, Toby.
It's Section 9. No postings in common areas without HR approval.
False. Section 9 is the fire code. I have read it.
Did you read the Cornell handbook too?
Toby has never been loved, so he can't stand anybody else being loved.

lines: I've filed eleven reports about Michael.
This is the first one about a board. It isn't in the fire code. I checked. I'm sad about it.

beats.text: Then take it down.
I'm approving it. Form 14-B. Three copies.
Fine. I'll write you a card, Toby.
Please don't.

scenes.recap: Michael tells Pam he won't cover for her again, and offers to stand guard if she calls Jim back.

beats.caption: sits in his car with a coffee, door open

beats.text: Michael.
I picked up Jim's call and said you weren't here. That wasn't mine to say.
I heard.
I'm not going to say it again. You have to tell him something true.
Thank you.

beats.caption: Michael clears his throat

beats.text: If you want to call him back, I'll stand outside the door. Like Prison Mike.
Prison Mike doesn't stand outside doors.
He does now.

scenes.recap: The Spring Social fight escalates over napkins and singing, and Phyllis splits the room.

beats.text: We need the room for hearts. Pink napkins. Heart-shaped ice.
No heart-shaped anything. It's a Garden Party.
I can sing at the Garden Party. Sweetheart harmony.
No singing.
Question: is singing a violation of the committee bylaws?
Yes, Dwight.

beats.caption: pulls a bag of pink napkins from his evidence drawer

beats.text: Exhibit A. Found in the supply closet. Kelly.
Those are for the Sweetheart Social, Dwight.
Let's split the room. Garden on the left, hearts on the right.
A split room is a crime against tablecloths.

beats.caption: Angela looks at the cats on her clipboard

beats.text: Hearts on the right. Cats on the left. Nobody touches the cats.

scenes.recap: Michael reads the Love Board 2.0 cards aloud, and Toby's card says 'be present.'

beats.caption: reads Love Board 2.0 cards aloud to the room

beats.text: Kelly says I'm like a cat with a laser.
Michael is the best manager. Acting not included.
Mine says gentleman, scholar, Cornell-adjacent.
Michael. M&M. Good.
Toby, what does yours say?
Blank.

beats.caption: Michael turns the blank card over and over

beats.text: A blank card means no words, which means honest.
I wrote one for you. It says be present.

beats.caption: Michael reads it twice

beats.text: That's not a card, Toby. That's a survey.

scenes.recap: Pam calls Jim from reception, leaves a four-word voicemail, and Michael hands her the phone instead of covering.

beats.caption: dials Stamford from the reception line

beats.text: It's ringing.
Want me to say you're not here? I'm very good at it now.
Please don't.

beats.caption: gets voicemail and starts a message

beats.text: Hi, it's Pam. I got your card. I—

beats.caption: Pam hangs up before finishing

beats.text: That was four words.
Thank you for not saying I'm not here.

lines: I left a voicemail. It had maybe four words in it.
I'm not ready for the other words. I'm pretty sure I'm not ready.

beats.text: One hundred ninety-five.
One ninety-five. That's what she said.

beats.caption: Stanley keeps filling in the puzzle

beats.text: Nobody say nothing.

lines: Michael has been making that joke for years. I've been counting for years.
I'm not going to say it's nice. I'm not going to say it isn't.

beats.text: Mm.
Was that a nod?
Did I stutter?
